title: docs(audit): pre-governance boundary scan + asset-recovery archaeology (read-only evidence baseline)
intent: Commit the read-only pre-governance archaeology evidence baseline. Two companion audit artifacts: (1) PRE_GOVERNANCE_SCAN establishes the governance-sprint boundary witnessed from git (soft start 2026-05-11; C0-C2 constitutional baseline 2026-05-18 c597c8a7/c12a9485, merged PR #16 e9644dc6 - correcting a remembered 'May 12' which is GOV-2/3 authority docs, a ramp milestone) and classifies transition-zone commits and dormant branches by reachability. (2) PRE_GOVERNANCE_ASSET_RECOVERY establishes a four-family recovery taxonomy (STRANDED / PRESERVED-TRANSITION / SET-ASIDE / ARCHITECTURAL-DNA) with a specimen matrix using explicit epistemic states, deep-works retopo and BOE/IBG, structures the remaining specimens with named next-archaeology steps, and specifies detector REQUIREMENTS only (no implementation). Read-only; classifies, builds nothing.
behavior_change: none - documentation only. Read-only forensic audit. No code, schema, route, workflow, data file, branch, or governance authority modified. The Consolidation Lab and CONV-002 are cited, not re-adjudicated. No SYSENG-CONVERGE-001 program created. No namespace-authority detector built (requirements only).
